entries.title: Verify your game history on-chain
entries.summary: Your profile now shows your real blockchain activity: every roll and win is backed by a Solana transaction you can open and verify yourself.
details: On-chain activity transparency (admin + player views): new server-side Wallets & accounts tracker in scripts/endpoints-probe.mjs (buildAccountsTracker + latestSignatures). It inventories every wallet/PDA the site touches: sponsor/house wallet, house dice PDA (via houseDicePda() with PDA-derivation fallback), and up to 10 sponsored player wallets + their dice PDAs from the spend ledger. Each entry carries its role, a gasless/who-pays note, live SOL balance, real-time ER delegation status from the Magic Router (getDelegationStatus), and the latest on-chain tx signatures from the devnet public RPC (best-effort, 8s timeout, fails open with an error string).

Tracker runs its checks concurrently (Promise.allSettled) so a slow public RPC cannot serialize the whole probe; it builds its own createConnection so it is independent of the main probe connection. Wired into the probe payload as ops.accounts with a { error } fail-safe so a tracker failure never breaks the dashboard.

Admin dashboard (dashboard/index.html) gains a "Wallets & accounts" section: clickable per-account SolanaFM + official-explorer links (via the existing gfg-explorer.js), ER delegation badge, SOL balance, gasless note, and the latest tx links with timestamps. Purple-bordered so it stands apart from the ops panel.

Profile page (profile/index.html) gains "Blockchain identity" (the wallet now carries an on-chain account link) and a new "Your on-chain activity" card that lists the last 8 point_transactions whose match_id is a proof-roll signature (game, reason, points, clickable tx link), so players can open and verify their own rolls and win rewards on-chain.
Verified live on devnet: probe watchlist 8/8 ok; sponsor balance 92.8896 SOL; house dice PDA delegated=true to the ER validator; both carry recent tx signatures.

entries.title: Latency benchmark: ER is the playable path
entries.summary: Measured real dice-roll latency on devnet. MagicBlock's Ephemeral Rollup handles dice at ~1.7s (gasless) vs ~4.8s for the paid base-chain queue — and board moves run on the ER at ~10-20ms, invisible to players.
details: built scripts/lab/bench-roll-comparison.mjs (LEG=base|er|web2|all) measuring send->VRF-result on real devnet transactions
ER VRF queue 5hBR57...: avg ~1.7s, p95 ~2.0s (devnet oracle callback dominates)
Base paid queue Cuj97...: avg ~4.8s, p95 ~5.1s — 2.8x slower than ER
Web2 local Math.random: 0.0ms (5000 samples) — the honest baseline row
root cause of earlier bench failure: rollOn passed sponsor as playerAuthority for a PDA keyed to a fresh keypair => ConstraintSeeds(2006); fixed by separating payer vs authority
client already uses the fast ER queue (src/gfg-dice-config.js:25) — no code change needed for the fast path
benchmarks.html added at /games/ludo-lab/benchmarks.html for the marketing/3-way comparison story
Solana mainnet NOW ~75ms avg response (Jonas Hahn, Solana Fdn DevRel, Aug 11 2026); FluxRPC YellowSockets is a base-layer RPC optimization only — does not speed ER rolls

entries.title: Anti-cheat architecture decided: chain-authoritative earn mode
entries.summary: Decided the Play-to-Earn version will validate every move on-chain (consensus-enforced, ~10-20ms), so cheaters can't fake wins or farm rewards. A separate 'Play for Fun' mode stays lightweight for casual players.
details: client-authoritative is a milk-the-sponsor risk once real rewards launch -> chain-authoritative for ALL state-changing moves in earn mode

pattern proven by live open-source projects: Magic UNO (every card play on ER, sub-10ms), DesiDash (every tap 8-18ms, batch commits), WhoRugUs (moves/tasks/votes as signed ER txs, VRF roles, PER for secrets), rock-paper-scissor official example
dice must stay ER VRF (~1.7s) — provability IS the product; hide it inside the existing 3.5s dice animation window
computer turns are just another signer; automation does not create a trust gap
two-version plan: fun (client authority, no financial impact) vs earn (on-chain authority, reward gated on on-chain state)
revert rule if felt latency >~2.5s p95: fall back to local AI rolls + keep ER only for proof roll + final record

roadmap.title: Full on-chain Ludo upgrade
roadmap.summary: Your Ludo match — every roll, move and win — becomes a permanent, tamper-proof record you can trust, with the same fast, easy play you have now.
details: Migrate Ludo match state fully on-chain: dice rolls, turns, moves, win/detection
Explore ER record_points for points/rewards mirroring game decisions
Goal: no client-side state a bad actor could fake; server/chain is source of truth
Keep web2 feel: instant moves, no per-action wallet pops, human-speed AI turns

Scope A (approved, IN PROGRESS): ALL dice rolls on the ER VRF (fast/gasless queue), not just the first user roll. Human "You" seat: every roll via the player's delegated dice PDA (session key signs silently, gasless). Computer seats: new server-side house-key route POST /api/roll performs each computer roll gasless on the ER VRF (house dice account sponsored+delegated once; key never leaves the server); roll returns roll1/roll2/seed/signature for display + proof.

Scope A intent: remove client-side Math.random for ALL dice so every roll (human + computer) is provably fair and verifiable. NO offline fallback for core dice: a failed roll is retried (3 attempts), then if the chain is genuinely down the match PAUSES with a visible banner (no local roll, no fake advance) and auto-resumes with an alert when the network returns (8s monitor pings base RPC + ER RPC). Devnet-wipe recovery: redeploy, restore points/game txs from Supabase, fresh games continue.

Scope B (planned, NOT started): record_points on the ER so points/rewards are recorded on-chain keyed to the proof roll; Supabase stays aggregation/fallback. Scope C (optional bundled): on-chain finish-order record.

roadmap.title: Free-with-limits value model (spendable points)
roadmap.summary: Play free every day within a fair limit, and when you want more, top up with spendable points. No hidden fees and no surprises, so the game stays sustainable and your wins stay provable.
details: Value model (mainnet phase, agreed shape): "free today, honest about limits." Free tier = a daily renewing sponsor-cost allowance per player, metered by real sponsor balance-delta from the spend ledger (not arbitrary roll counts) and shown to the player as "free plays left today".

Top-up: players can fund their embedded Solana wallet (Dynamic on-ramp) and buy spendable points; points unlock extra allowance and specials (lives, tournament re-entries). Earned and purchased points share the existing point_transactions ledger (different reason tags).

Early refill: during the onboarding phase players can request a free allowance refill from their profile (owner grants). The limit is taught from day one so later removal of free refills is never a surprise.

Transparency: per-game sponsor cost, allowance used, wins and turns are tracked and visible on both the user profile and the admin dashboard, so the owner can see how far the free gas budget stretches (games/turns per SOL).

Competition fairness: competitions are never pay-to-enter; each event bundles an allowance sized to finish it. Paid pressure applies to extra/grinding play, never to locking a player out of an event they already entered.

roadmap.title: Platform economy: 3-point ledgers, 2 level systems, competitions + brand sponsorships
roadmap.summary: Your points finally have real, lasting value: a lifetime record that never expires, spendable points you can use anywhere, and a per-game record that proves how good you are at each game. Level up to earn multipliers on wins and an ad-free experience, and compete in events with guaranteed, locked-in prizes.
details: REDESIGN (agreed shape at strategy session, design-phase; devnet-safe pieces may ship first, mainnet = revenue phase). Owner framing: honest about limits from day one, never bait-and-switch; points must have sources AND sinks or they carry no value; winners of competitions never pay for their won points.

THREE POINT LEDGERS (all reason-tagged in existing point_transactions audit; Supabase aggregation + on-chain record_points PDA as verifiable layer): (1) GLOBAL LIFETIME - non-spendable, permanent, every point from every source (won/bought/giveaway/referral) accumulates forever, never decays, drives Lifetime Rank + loyal/O.G. rewards (anniversaries). (2) GLOBAL SPENDABLE - the exchange currency, spendable anywhere on the platform: buys Active Tier, cosmetics, competition entries, stakes; goes up and down; this is what purchases top up. (3) LOCAL PER-GAME points - per-game detailed verifiable record of how points were earned (already exists as lifetime Ludo points in local-points.js); drives per-game skill reputation and gates game-specific unlocks.

TWO LEVEL SYSTEMS: (A) Lifetime Rank - permanent, earned (lifetime points + account age, e.g. 5,000 lifetime AND 1 month old -> Rank 2; level-up gates like duration), never drops, never lost, unlocks O.G./legacy rewards and future specials. (B) Active Tier - temporary, monthly, bought from spendable points (current 500 level = Active Tier 2 now; Tier N costs scale up) - paying deducts from spendable balance (1,000 total minus 500 tier cost = 500 left). Multipliers by tier: 2x/3x/4x on win point rewards. Renews monthly or expires: if it lapses MID-competition, access locks but the leaderboard keeps points earned within the window; re-up instantly restores entry.

EARN COMPETITIONS: skilled entry (Active Tier/level gate + small entry fee in spendable points), never pay-to-win - claiming won rewards is free (tennis analogy: pay a little to enter, win covers it, higher wins cover more). Prizes from pooled entries + sponsor/brand top-ups + platform rake.

BRAND-SPONSORED COMPETITIONS (web3-native upsell): brands fund a prize pool for a chosen game + rules; PLATFORM 30% / WINNERS 70%. Prize LOCKED in a smart-contract escrow (PDAs on the ER program, same gfg-dice owner) BEFORE the event, winners claim by program logic automatically - a brand can never promise and then stiff winners (protects our brand). Proven patterns already exist on Solana: BracketChain escrow-vault PDAs, SkillOS permissionless sponsor pools, PYMSTR batch payouts. Build our own escrow PDA to avoid third-party custody.

ADS: inline banners ONLY (no popups/interstitials that break the game), shown on the free tier; upgrading to a higher Active Tier removes ads. Level 1 sees low-fill banner, higher tiers ad-free. Web2 first: Google AdSense H5 Game Ads (easiest start, $8-15 Tier-1 CPM but Tier-3 Nigeria is $1-4 - ads are a support line, not the business), then Ezoic/Playwire/AdinPlay for gaming-optimized fill, web3 (Adshares/BigAds) only when crypto-native demand exists.

PURCHASES: no Stripe, no app stores. Player funds the embedded Dynamic wallet via on-ramp (card/bank in local currency), buys spendable points in-app; points minted SERVER-SIDE only after a verified on-chain payment (security-queue rule - never trust a client-claimed paid flag). This is the buy-to-join moment Ludo King monetizes, early-phase softened by referral/giveaway/social-share earn paths.

OPEN BLIND-SPOTS (from owner review): (1) DOUBLE-CREDIT risk - do NOT let one win credit both local-spendable AND global-spendable (inflation); instead game-exclusives are gated by local lifetime balance + charged from global spendable. (2) MULTIPLIER INFLATION - 2x/3x/4x everywhere mints faster than tiers cost; apply multipliers to base match rewards only (never stake returns) + per-day cap, keep sinks (comp entries, cosmetics) draining faster than multipliers mint. (3) LEGALITY (mainnet-framing) - Ludo is a game of chance; pay-to-enter cash-prize chance games are restricted in several jurisdictions (India notably); keep entry predominantly earned-points + small, pay prizes in points, real value via escrow with clear T&Cs; legal review before mainnet cash comps.

HARD CONSTRAINT: tracks under the Value model (free today, honest about limits) umbrella (approved roadmap item). Anti-abuse hardening (server-authoritative allowance/tier metering, purchase verification, refill farming, multiplier circumvention) lives in docs/changelog/security-queue.md, NEVER client-served.

roadmap.title: Platform economy: revenue-first build order (ledgers -> tier -> comps -> rails)
details: What is on-chain now (two aspects, both devnet + gasless, players hold 0 SOL): (1) DICE - every roll goes through MagicBlock VRF on the ER (human via the player's delegated dice PDA gfgplayerd signed by the session key; computers via the house sponsor key server-side). The roll result plus entropy seed land in the dice PDA and the roll tx signature is the verifiable proof. (2) REWARDS - a 1st-place win that had a valid on-chain roll fires record_points on the player's points PDA (gfgpoints); it stores total_points, award_count, last_points/last_reason/last_match_ref where last_match_ref = first 8 bytes of the winning roll sig, binding the reward to the exact roll. The record_points tx signature is the authoritative receipt. What stays off-chain: board state, token moves, turns, and Supabase profile totals (aggregation/fallback only).

On-chain points (Scope B, implemented + verified live on devnet): new PlayerPoints ledger account (seed gfgpoints) + initialize_points/delegate_points/record_points instructions on the same delegated gfg-dice program (program id unchanged).

Relay handleDelegate now creates AND delegates BOTH per-player PDAs (dice gfgplayerd + points gfgpoints) in one idempotent call; fresh onboarding = 4 steps ~0.0086 SOL; per-player spend cap default raised 0.005 -> 0.012 SOL (covers two PDAs with margin).

Client recordPoints(points, reason, matchRef): pure gasless ER write (session key signs, 0-SOL player) returning the receipt signature; matchRefFromSignature = first 8 bytes of the proof-roll sig as u64; fetchPointsPda reads the player's own ledger; POINT_REASONS.WIN_1ST=1.
win-detection: after the Supabase +100 1st-place award (proof roll gated), fires recordPoints(100, 1, matchRef) as a soft-fail mirror that never blocks the win UX, and logs the receipt explorer link.
Admin tracker lists each wallet's dice PDA AND points PDA (live delegation status); dashboard renders both. Profile page adds "Your on-chain points ledger" card (own account only, gasless read).
Supabase stays aggregation/fallback; the on-chain record is the permanent verifiable layer (re-sync on devnet wipe).
Scope C (parked): on-chain finish-order record so a full game result (1st..4th) is also committed, not just the reward points.

DECIDED (2026-08-14, econ-003): Active Tier ladder anchored to the 100-pt 1st-place win. Tier 1 free 1x. Tier 2 = 1,000 spendable/mo -> 2x. Tier 3 = 2,500 spendable/mo -> 3x. Tier 4 = 5,000 spendable/mo -> 4x. Multiplier applies ONLY to base match win points (100 -> 200/300/400), never stake returns / comp prizes / referral gifts. Per-day multiplier cap +1,000 boosted pts (about 10 extra 100-pt wins) so whales can't mint infinite points.

DECIDED (2026-08-14, econ-006): SEVEN revenue streams that decide the build order (revenue first, features second). (1) On-ramp: buy spendable points via embedded wallet, server-verified after on-chain payment (primary). (2) Brand event rake 30/70, prizes on-chain escrowed (SOL BracketChain/SkillOS pattern, our own escrow PDA on the ER program). (3) Active Tier monthly buy (the 2x/3x/4x ladder drains spendable back into the on-ramp). (4) Ads support line (free tier inline banners + opt-in rewarded video, Nigeria Tier-3 CPM $1-4). (5) Cosmetics store non-NFT (board themes / dice skins / avatar frames, spendable sink). (6) Stake mode rake (small fixed per pot, skilled-first, never pay-to-win). (7) Tournament licence (hosted community/brand events, fee or revenue share).

BUILD ORDER (revenue-first, econ-006 + econ-002/003/004): (S0) point ledgers exist today (lifetime + per-game; spendable balance is next). (S1) Active Tier + multipliers + spendable sink (the money engine). (S2) Earn competitions + brand escrow (30/70 rake). (S3) Monetization rails: on-ramp buy-flow + cosmetics store. (S4) Ads + rewarded video (support line, only after real traffic). (S5) Stake mode rake. (S6) Tournament licence. Each stage gates what we build; nothing is built before its revenue reason exists.

S1 implementation notes: new profile columns active_tier (int), active_tier_expires_at (timestamptz), tier_boost_used_today (int), tier_boost_day (date). Client: tiers.js helpers getActiveTierProfile / buyActiveTier / computeWinReward wired into the Ludo win path; header shows tier badge; profile page shows a buy card. Server-authoritative metering is a mainnet security item (security-queue), client-first on devnet.
